scope: Fresh native victory encounters only. Raw telemetry and its declared required-candidate flags remain unchanged; these reviewed source classifications apply only to the exported readiness ledger.

entries.reason: UrGhastFireball.onHitEntity uses native damageSources.fireball with its Ur-Ghast owner, producing minecraft:fireball. Vanilla tags this source as fire; native Fire Resistance returns before incoming-damage processing. The winning apple-equipped encounter therefore retains its unobserved player direct-fireball profile. Native generic explosion and tear receipts did process and are independently observed. Earlier controlled direct-impact callbacks are separate evidence.

entries.reason: The sole registered WhipAndSpearGoal receives attackrange8 and attackMinrange15. Its superclass canUse requires target distance<8 while its own canUse simultaneously requires distance>=15, so the installed fresh encounter selector cannot select state25. Review of the installed Scylla main/nested setters and exhaustive constant-pool references found no alternative native state25 assignment. Saved/external state injection is outside this classification. The raw missing candidate remains preserved and is not counted as observed.

entries.reason: The heavy setting is the upper raw-damage bound inside the mace_rage decision. The production selector returns arrow, anima.cap or mace_rage for this boss and never emits a separate heavy profile. The telemetry catalogue imported the setting as if it were another emitted profile. Native mace_rage observations establish the processing family. This classification neither claims the cap threshold was reached nor removes any required native attack state.
entries.source: src/main/java/survival/balance/BossDamageBalance.java lines262-271. The selector returns decision(maledictus.mace_rage, Math.min(scaledNative, raw(maledictus.heavy))). EncounterTelemetry imports configured profile candidates.
